title: Strengthening National Forest Policy in Timor-Leste
desc: Through the project. FAO technical expertise will be made available to support the government in (1) carrying out the assessment of strengths and weaknesses of NFP and in finalizing the draft forest law, resulting in recommendations to strengthen both the policy and the law (2) formulating of national community forestry action plan based on assessment of field conditions and stakeholders? interest and support capacity, and (3) developing the capacity for implementation of the national community forestry action plan.

title: Enhancing Food and Nutrition Security and Reducing Disaster Risk through the Promotion of Conservation Agriculture in the Fragile Environments of Atauro Island and Nino Koni Santana National Park
desc: The expected outcome of the Project is the adjustment of current cropping and fisheries management towards conservation agriculture, permaculture and integrated fisheries techniques promoting sustainable production intensification and diversification of smallholder farming and fishing systems on Atauro Island of Dili District and the Nino Konis Santana National Park in Lautem District.

title: Enhancing Food and Nutrition Security through the Promotion of Conservation Agriculture (and Other Climate Change Adaptation Measures)
desc: The expected outcome of the Project is the adjustment of current cropping management towards conservation agriculture technologies and practices promoting production intensification and diversification of smallholder farming systems in Baucau, Ermera, Manatuto and Manufahi Districts of Timor-Leste.

title: TCPF: Support to the Development of Agricultural Policy
desc: The objective of this project is to provide needed support to the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries (MAF) to revise its overall agriculture sector policy and to formulate an agricultural mechanization policy.

title: TCPF: Preparation of UTF Timor-Leste GAFSP/SAPIP

title: TCPF: Develop the Timor-Leste regulation on pesticides and the use of chemicals
desc:
The Overall objective is to make available the necessary technical assistance to MAF for draft the pesticide law. Specific objectives include:

- Review current practices on pesticide (and other chemical) imports, use and disposal in Timor-Leste
- Review the existing draft pesticide law and organize stakeholder consultations at various levels for inputs and feedback on the draft law and needs for improvement
- Revise the draft law and submit for government approval 
- Develop a user manual for proper and safe application of pesticide and other chemicals

title: TCPF: Development of ZEESM-TL irrigation water distribution system and management framework
desc: The objective of the project is to provide the needed technical assistance to the ZEESM-TL authority to develop an irrigation management policy and to design the Tono irrigation water distribution and management system.

title: 経済社会開発計画（道路補修整備機材）
desc: 老朽化した道路や、雨季の自然災害により繰り返し損壊している道路を補修するための道路整備機材（路面切削機、アスファルト舗装機等）を供与し、基礎的なインフラである道路の維持管理能力を向上させることにより、同国における災害に対して強靱な道路整備を後押しするもの。

title: 東ティモール太陽光発電事業
desc: 東ティモールのマナトゥト県において、太陽光発電所（73.7MW）及び蓄電池（80.2MWh）を含む関連設備の建設・運営を通じ、化石燃料依存からの脱却を図り、もって同国の温室効果ガス排出削減に寄与するもの。

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: PF 10-583 FarMar Agro Enterprise in Timor Leste - AMS #A12853
desc: Working with ADRA NZ to grow the rural economy of the Viqueque Municipality through market-orientated agro-enterprise, and to improve food security in Timor-Leste. The Activity aims to better connect smallholder farmers to markets and agricultural support services.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: PF 10-586 Expanding early childhood care and education in Timor Leste (A12854)
desc: Working with UNICEF NZ to provide early childhood care and education to 185 communities in Timor-Leste.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Early Childhood Education (Timor-Leste)
desc: The Early Childhood Education (ECE) activity is being implemented in Timor-Leste over 2021-2026. The goal is that children grow into healthy and productive citizens who can contribute to the country's social and economic well-being. The Activity aims to achieve this by raising the quality of ECE, and expanding access to it.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: COVID-19 Response: Civil Society (Timor-Leste)
desc: Funding for NGO initiatives aimed at improving Timor-Leste's preparedness for the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic through hygiene and sanitation items and public health education.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: COVID-19 Response: Personal Protective Equipment Support to Timor-Leste
desc: This Activity is to provide personal protective equipment (PPE) to healthcare workers to support Timor-Leste's efforts to combat COVID-19. This support is a direct response to the Government of Timor-Leste's written formal request to assist with the procurement of PPE.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Crop Diversification in Timor-Leste
desc: New Zealand will support income-generation opportunities amongst rural Timorese farm households through increased diversification of export-oriented crops.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: PASK (Community Security Support Programme / Programa Apoiu Seguransa Komunidade)
desc: PASK will support initiatives aimed at improving community security by strengthening participatory governance and promoting the community policing approach within the Timor-Leste police force.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: 2021 COVID-19 EHEF Timor-Leste
desc: New Zealand Emergency High Commission/Embassy Funding to support Timor-Leste in response to a significant spike in COVID-19 cases in early 2021.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: 2021 Flood Response Timor-Leste
desc: New Zealand emergency relief and early recovery support for Timor-Leste following the heavy flooding and COVID-19 outbreak.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: COVID-19 and Flood Response in Timor Leste (2021): UNICEF
desc: Support for provision of humanitarian relief in Timor-Leste following catastrophic 4 April flooding, and in response to community transmission of Covid-19.  Activities include distribution of humanitarian supplies to flood-affected families, provision of water and sanitation facilities in evacuation shelters, nutrition and education support for mothers and children, and social protection (including child protection and people with disabilities).

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Timor-Leste In-Country Short Term Training 2022: English Language Training
desc:
This Activity aims to:
  • support Timor-Leste’s bid for ASEAN membership by increasing English language capability in the public service, and their ability to engage with ASEAN counterparts;
  • enable private sector and NGOs to better engage with international partners, including New Zealand;
  • offer a relevant and valued alternative to language training online or in New Zealand during border closures
through the provision of English Language training to scholars in Timor-Leste.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Dili Scholar and Alumni Event Fund 2022-2023
desc: The fund is administered through the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships Programme and can be accessed by all Posts where there are scholars and alumni of the Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Timor-Leste 2023 Short Term Scholarships
desc: This Activity aims to increase the knowledge and skills of individuals so that they can contribute to the development of Timor-Leste and positively impact the bilateral relationship by providing short term scholarships (less than one year in length) to scholars from Timor-Leste. These short term scholarships can take the form of vocational training, an apprenticeship, or other workplace experience.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Timor-Leste 2023 Tertiary Scholarships
desc:
Tertiary scholarships are offered to Timor Leste to progress development and workforce planning objectives. Anticipated outcomes include:
  • The capability of scholars is increased
  • Scholars develop personal and professional connections to each other
  • Affinity is increased between New Zealand and scholars through a positive scholarship experience
  • Bilateral and regional objectives are supported by the Scholarships Programme

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Climate Finance for Community Resilience: Oxfam Aotearoa
desc: This activity strengthens resilience of vulnerable households in Oecusse and Liquiçá to climate change using gender-transformative and disability-inclusive methods to promote equitable responses and disaster risk reduction, through: 1) water security and climate-smart agriculture promoting biodiversity; 2) strengthened capacity of local partners on gender-transformative and disability-inclusive climate change adaptation programmes, 3) elevating voices of women and people with disabilities.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Climate Finance for Community Resilience: UNICEF Aotearoa
desc:
This activity will focus work in Aileu and Dili municipalities to:
  • mobilise communities to construct and maintain nature-based water retention solutions including check dams, retention ponds, reservoirs, terracing, and reforestation, prioritising biodiversity.
  • increase knowledge, skills, of water retention solutions and rainwater harvesting and construct rainwater harvesting facilities in schools. 
All activities will proactively include youth, women and people with disabilities.

desc: TL-PSP creates concrete opportunities for inclusive and sustainable private investment through targeted advisory and creating markets upstream interventions. The Activity improves private sector competitiveness by tackling key market-wide constraints that restrain viable, sustainable private sector investment in key sectors and fostering new market opportunities. It seeks to lock in resilient, gender and climate-smart private sector growth into Timor-Leste’s long term development trajectory.

desc: This activity brings together communities and police to increase their awareness of each other's role in providing security. It specifically aims to increase the capacity of the police and communities to successfully implement community policing on the ground, and to establish Community Policing Councils to set security agendas and priorities, improve coordination and monitoring, and serve as critical entry points for communities to engage the police.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

desc: Working with ChildFund in Timor Leste to install boreholes, protected water sources and demonstration latrines into schools and communities. Education promoters will be trained to conduct awareness and education sessions.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Financial Literacy training programme
desc: Delivery of financial literacy training tailored to the needs of women, as well as leadership opportunities through training of trainers. Trainees develop literacy skills, critical thinking skills and entrepreneurship skills.

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
title: Timor Leste NZ Scholarships Tertiary Studies

donor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
